_source: First-party turn-by-turn Demon Lord DAMAGE walkthrough (user, 2026-08-06). CB HARD, Void key, DonaHilvi team Ezio/Ninja/Michelangelo/Xenomorph/Iudex Artor. Champs under Veil. Purpose: calibrate the boss's per-hit damage (CB_BOSS_HIT, CB_CRUSH_PCT, and the Gathering-Fury ramp) from reality, not fitted totals. Colors appear to be the STRUCK CHAMP's affinity tint (Magic=yellow, Force/Void=red), NOT crit.

bossTurns.note: 1-hit Void AoE, no debuff; base ATK-vs-DEF. Pins CB_BOSS_HIT Hard≈2460 (Ninja exact).

2-hit AoE WITH Decrease ATK on the boss (confirms the #1 survival lever cuts his AoEs). Numbers may be per-hit or 2-hit total — TBD. Per-champ order is noisy (Ninja highest despite mid DEF) — likely per-hit crit/variance.
F(11)=2.5× (reviewer formula, BOSS turns). Ninja 4941 vs base×F = 1544×2.5=3860 → the extra is per-hit crit/variance (the numbers are noisy). Team still alive.
⭐ First champ death at boss turn 14 (F(14)=4.75×), Artor to a 6514 Dark Nova. Clean SURVIVAL anchor. Sim (real mode) fully wipes at boss turn ~16 — survival TIMING now ~right.

gatheringFury: REVIEWER FORMULA (implemented 2026-08-06): F(T) on BOSS turns — T<10:1×; 10-19: 1+0.75(T-9); T>=20: 8.5+(T-19). F(10)=1.75 F(11)=2.5 F(14)=4.75 F(20)=9.5 F(50)=39.5. Additive on pre-Fury damage, before DEF.
_calibration_status: BOSS side calibrated to reality: CB_BOSS_HIT Hard=2460 (turn-1 Dark Nova, Ninja exact), CB_CRUSH_PCT=0.113 (turn-3 Crushing Force), Gathering Fury on GLOBAL turns (turn-11 per-hit ~matches). ⚠ THE RESIDUAL IS TEAM SUSTAIN, NOT THE BOSS: with the boss calibrated, the sim's team WIPES at boss-turn ~11 (banks ~2M) while reality survives to bank 9.88M — because the sim under-models the team's HEALING/LIFESTEAL/REVIVE throughput (capture: Ninja healed 713k, Iudex Artor revives). The survival model ('real') is therefore OPT-IN (SIM_CB_SURVIVE=real); default stays 'optimistic' until sustain is calibrated. NEXT: reproduce reality's per-champ HEALED column (713k Ninja etc.) — check lifesteal gear/heal cadence/revive firing.
